CORRECTED REVIEW PANEL DETERMINATION
NRS 281A.730; NAC 281A.440
On May 7, 2025, the Nevada Commission on Ethics (“Commission”) received the
above-entitled Ethics Complaint (“Complaint”) against Jimmy Floyd (“Subject”) and
instructed the Executive Director to investigate alleged violations of NRS 281A.400(2),
(3), and (9).
During all material times, Subject was a public employee as defined in NRS
281A.150. The Commission has jurisdiction over this matter pursuant to NRS 281A.280
because the allegations contained in the Complaint relate to Subject’s conduct as a public
employee and associated implications under the Ethics Law.
On September 3, 2025, a Review Panel consisting of Chair Scherer (Presiding
Officer), Commissioner Langton and Commissioner Miller considered the following: (1)
Ethics Complaint; (2) Order on Jurisdiction and Investigation; (3) Subject’s Response;
and (4) Executive Director’s Recommendation to the Review Panel with Summary of
Investigatory Findings and Relevant Evidentiary Exhibits.1
The Review Panel unanimously finds and concludes the facts and evidence
establish credible evidence that the Subject failed to comply with the requirements of NRS
281A.400(2) and (3) and that just and sufficient cause exists to refer this matter to the
Commission for further proceedings. There is insufficient evidence to refer allegations
related to NRS 281A.400(9).
1 All materials provided to the Review Panel, except the Ethics Complaint and the Order on Jurisdiction and
Investigation, represent portions of the investigatory file and remain confidential pursuant to NRS 281A.755.
Review Panel Determination

Therefore, this Complaint is referred to the Commission for adjudicatory
proceedings and a determination with respect to NRS 281A.400(2) and (3).
Dated this 3rd day of September, 2025
